name: QRY-0192
sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT `tabActivity`.title) AS `Activity`
  FROM `tabActivity` AS `tabActivity`
 INNER JOIN `tabLearner Submission` AS `tabLearner Submission`
    ON `tabActivity`.name = `tabLearner Submission`.activity_reference
 WHERE `tabLearner Submission`.learner_cohort IN ('MAR_5A: Maruti Vidyalaya', 'SGR_5: Sri Sadguru Sai Baba HPS', 'Grade 5-2025-26')
 LIMIT 100
title: LEAP Activities

name: QRY-0195
sql:
SELECT `tabLearner Submission`.learner_cohort AS `Learner Cohort`,
       `tabLearner Submission`.learner_display_name AS `Learner Display Name`,
       `tabLearner Submission`.activity_title AS `Activity Title`,
       `tabAssessment Output`.transcription_language AS `Transcription Language`,
       `tabAssessment Output`.transcription_language_reason AS `Transcription Language Reason`,
       `tabAssessment Output`.audio_response_recording AS `Audio Response Recording`,
       `tabAssessment Output`.learner_speech_diarized AS `Learner Speech Diarized`
  FROM `tabLearner Submission` AS `tabLearner Submission`
 INNER JOIN `tabAssessment Output` AS `tabAssessment Output`
    ON `tabLearner Submission`.name = `tabAssessment Output`.parent
 GROUP BY `tabLearner Submission`.learner_cohort,
          `tabLearner Submission`.learner_display_name,
          `tabLearner Submission`.activity_title,
          `tabAssessment Output`.transcription_language,
          `tabAssessment Output`.transcription_language_reason,
          `tabAssessment Output`.audio_response_recording,
          `tabAssessment Output`.learner_speech_diarized
